persona: Event agency coordinator moving to an in-house event marketing role
resumeText:
Sneha Iyer | Bengaluru | sneha.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Senior Event Coordinator, Lotus Lane Events, Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Planned and executed 30 corporate conferences and product launches for clients of 200 to 1,500 guests.
- Managed stall fabrication and logistics for clients at trade shows in Bengaluru, Mumbai and Delhi NCR.
- Organised annual dealer meets for a two-wheeler client with 600 dealers in Goa and Jaipur.
- Handled venue booking and briefed AV, fabrication and hospitality vendors for every event.
- Ran mall and college BTL activations for a consumer electronics brand across six cities.

Event Executive, Lotus Lane Events, Bengaluru (2021 - 2022)
- Prepared event run sheets and managed guest registration desks.

EDUCATION
BBA, Christ University, Bengaluru, 2021

SKILLS
Event budgets, MS Excel, Canva
